title: A New Take on Cake
description: All normal cakes now become delicious chocolate cakes!
body:
## What it does
This mod simply changes the texture of a normal, boring cake into that of a chocolate cake.

Yep, the item too!
## Why use this mod?
Don't you really hate the **boringness** of normal Minecraft cakes? Well, this mod is here to spice it up with chocolate cakes! (More cakes coming soon, watch my profile!)
